#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Independent reference planner on the uncompressed published network.

Feasibility by repeated max-flow over the public ratio set, optimality by
negative-cycle cancelling on the residual circulation. Deliberately naive;
used only to cross-check the submitted planner on small and medium epochs.
"""
from fractions import Fraction

INF = float('inf')


class Net:
    def __init__(self, n):
        self.n = n
        self.to = []
        self.cap = []
        self.cost = []
        self.head = [-1] * n
        self.nxt = []

    def add(self, u, v, cap, cost=0):
        i = len(self.to)
        self.to.append(v); self.cap.append(cap); self.cost.append(cost)
        self.nxt.append(self.head[u]); self.head[u] = i
        self.to.append(u); self.cap.append(0); self.cost.append(-cost)
        self.nxt.append(self.head[v]); self.head[v] = i + 1
        return i


def dinic(g, s, t):
    n = g.n; to = g.to; cap = g.cap; nxt = g.nxt; head = g.head
    total = 0
    while True:
        level = [-1] * n; level[s] = 0; q = [s]
        for u in q:
            i = head[u]
            while i >= 0:
                if cap[i] > 0 and level[to[i]] < 0:
                    level[to[i]] = level[u] + 1; q.append(to[i])
                i = nxt[i]
        if level[t] < 0:
            return total
        it = head[:]

        def dfs(u, push):
            if u == t:
                return push
            i = it[u]
            while i >= 0:
                c = cap[i]
                if c > 0 and level[to[i]] == level[u] + 1:
                    d = dfs(to[i], min(push, c))
                    if d:
                        cap[i] -= d; cap[i ^ 1] += d; return d
                i = nxt[i]; it[u] = i
            return 0

        while True:
            f = dfs(s, 1 << 60)
            if not f:
                break
            total += f


def build(case, preds, thr, want, with_cost):
    S = len(case['slots']); J = len(case['windows'])
    F = len(case['flows']); G = len(case['groups'])
    times = [r[0] for r in case['slots']]
    caps = [r[1] for r in case['slots']]
    refill = [r[2] for r in case['slots']]
    B, I = case['bucket']
    W = 1 + J * times[-1]
    cv = case['class_values']
    value = [case['windows'][j][6] * cv[preds[j]] for j in range(J)]
    R, Z = 0, 1
    a = [2 + 3 * s for s in range(S)]
    b = [3 + 3 * s for s in range(S)]
    e = [4 + 3 * s for s in range(S)]
    base = 2 + 3 * S
    w = [base + j for j in range(J)]
    z = [base + J + f for f in range(F)]
    h = [base + J + F + g for g in range(G)]
    K = base + J + F + G
    ss, tt = K, K + 1
    g = Net(K + 2)
    for s in range(S):
        g.add(R, a[s], I if s == 0 else refill[s])
        g.add(a[s], b[s], B)
        if s + 1 < S:
            g.add(b[s], a[s + 1], B)
        g.add(b[s], e[s], caps[s])
    pairs = []
    for s in range(S):
        for j in range(J):
            win = case['windows'][j]
            if win[5] < thr[j] and win[1] <= times[s] <= win[2]:
                pairs.append((s, j))
                cost = (times[s] - win[1]) - value[j] * W if with_cost else 0
                g.add(e[s], w[j], 1, cost)
    for j in range(J):
        g.add(w[j], z[case['windows'][j][0]], 1)
    zarc = []
    for f in range(F):
        head = h[case['flows'][f][2]] if case['flows'][f][2] >= 0 else Z
        zarc.append(g.add(z[f], head, case['flows'][f][1] - want[f]))
    for gi in range(G):
        head = h[case['groups'][gi][0]] if case['groups'][gi][0] >= 0 else Z
        g.add(h[gi], head, case['groups'][gi][1])
    g.add(Z, R, J)
    ssa = []
    tta = []
    for f in range(F):
        head = h[case['flows'][f][2]] if case['flows'][f][2] >= 0 else Z
        ssa.append(g.add(ss, head, want[f]))
        tta.append(g.add(z[f], tt, want[f]))
    return g, ss, tt, sum(want), pairs, value, times, zarc


def feasible(case, preds, thr, want):
    g, ss, tt, need, _, _, _, _ = build(case, preds, thr, want, False)
    return dinic(g, ss, tt) == need


def cancel_cycles(g):
    n = g.n
    while True:
        dist = [0] * n
        pre = [-1] * n
        updated = -1
        for it in range(n + 1):
            updated = -1
            for i in range(len(g.to)):
                if g.cap[i] > 0:
                    u = g.to[i ^ 1]
                    v = g.to[i]
                    if dist[u] + g.cost[i] < dist[v]:
                        dist[v] = dist[u] + g.cost[i]
                        pre[v] = i
                        updated = v
            if updated < 0:
                return
        # negative cycle: walk back from updated
        node = updated
        for _ in range(n + 1):
            node = g.to[pre[node] ^ 1]
        cycle = []
        cur = node
        while True:
            i = pre[cur]
            cycle.append(i)
            cur = g.to[i ^ 1]
            if cur == node:
                break
        width = min(g.cap[i] for i in cycle)
        for i in cycle:
            g.cap[i] -= width
            g.cap[i ^ 1] += width


def solve(case, preds, thr):
    S = len(case['slots']); J = len(case['windows']); F = len(case['flows'])
    targets = [f[0] for f in case['flows']]
    rset = sorted({Fraction(k, t) for t in targets for k in range(t + 1)})
    best = Fraction(0)
    for level in rset:
        want = [(-((-level * t).numerator)) // (level * t).denominator for t in targets]
        if feasible(case, preds, thr, want):
            best = level
    want = [(-((-best * t).numerator)) // (best * t).denominator for t in targets]
    g, ss, tt, need, pairs, value, times, zarc = build(case, preds, thr, want, True)
    assert dinic(g, ss, tt) == need
    # cost of the mandatory phase is irrelevant; cancel cycles to optimality
    # zero out the SS/TT arcs from the residual so only real cycles remain
    for f in range(F):
        pass
    cancel_cycles(g)
    counts = [0] * F
    utility = 0
    age = 0
    off = 4 * S - 1
    for k, (s, j) in enumerate(pairs):
        pass
    # recompute from arc flows: eligibility arcs are indices off..off+len(pairs)
    # flow on arc i equals g.cap[i ^ 1]
    for k, (s, j) in enumerate(pairs):
        i = None
    # cheaper: walk arcs by scanning
    return best, g, pairs, value, times, want, S, J, F


def objective(case, preds, thr):
    best, g, pairs, value, times, want, S, J, F = solve(case, preds, thr)
    # recover the selected pairs by inspecting flow on eligibility arcs
    # eligibility arcs were added in order after the 4S-1 token arcs
    start = None
    # rebuild index mapping: token arcs count = 4S-1
    idx = 4 * S - 1
    utility = 0
    age = 0
    counts = [0] * F
    for (s, j) in pairs:
        flow = g.cap[idx ^ 1]
        if flow:
            utility += value[j]
            age += times[s] - case['windows'][j][1]
            counts[case['windows'][j][0]] += 1
        idx += 2
    cov = min([Fraction(1)] + [Fraction(counts[f], case['flows'][f][0]) for f in range(F)])
    assert cov == best, (cov, best)
    return best, utility, age, counts
PYEOF
